verificationSummary: Editor merge commit 011debfbcf55891ff142302bbfdf301cee5160b5 implements the bounded selection context summary foundation for the Inspector panel. SelectionContextSummary renders a Selected block context section above Inspector node actions and raw facts, showing the selected label, a role-first user-facing kind such as Heading, Type: text-block when a role refines the raw type, operation surface, child count, and Duplicate/Delete/Reorder capability badges. Focused RED first failed in src/tests/selectionContextSummary.test.ts because the Inspector did not render Selected block context and the component file did not exist; focused RED after browser review failed because a real text-block heading selection still surfaced Text Block instead of Heading. Focused GREEN passed npx vitest run src/tests/selectionContextSummary.test.ts --reporter verbose with 1 file and 2 tests. Editor worktree npm run check passed type-check, 89 passed test files, 307 passed tests, and build. Worktree browser evidence in live Backend mode opened /documents/product-report-vnext-minimal/design, confirmed the title summary showed Product Report for Customer, Heading, Type: text-block, Surface: text-block, Children: 0, Source: Backend read, Authoring: limited, then selected summary-columns and confirmed the summary changed to Columns with Surface: columns and Children: 2. Merged Editor main npm run check passed type-check, 89 passed test files, 307 passed tests, and build. Main browser evidence at http://127.0.0.1:65521/documents/product-report-vnext-minimal/design with Backend at http://127.0.0.1:65520 confirmed the same title and Columns selection summaries, Source: Backend read, Authoring: limited, summary-before-actions and actions-before-facts ordering, and no browser error logs. Vite still reports the existing chunk-size warning. Editor npm install in the lane still reported 5 high severity vulnerabilities. git deregistered the Editor worktree and deleted the merged branch, but the residual .worktrees/editor-selection-context-summary-foundation folder could not be removed because the local command policy blocked recursive deletion. This evidence supports only the bounded Editor Inspector selection context summary UI and does not promote broad Editor truth, WYSIWYG readiness, text input readiness, command authoring readiness, Backend mutation or persistence readiness, Backend production readiness, Core truth, accessibility readiness, visual regression readiness, durable storage readiness, PDF export readiness, bundle-size readiness, live production behavior, or FlowDoc product readiness.
